newsitem.title: GERMANY: Degussa has no immediate takeover plans.
newsitem.headline: Degussa has no immediate takeover plans.

text.p: German chemicals, metals and drugs group Degussa AG said on Tuesday that it would consider making further acquisitions but had no concrete plans at the moment.

Management board member Guenter Wohlenberg told a news conference acquistions could never be planned far in advance as they often came up at short notice and a company needs to be ready to jump at opportunities presenting themselves.
"We will continue to make acquisitions on a smaller scale," he said, adding the group however had nothing specific in mind at the moment.

The group's chief executive Uwe-Ernst Bufe added that Degussa, which in the past had sold off some businesses in a bid to concentrate more on core activities, also was not planning more disinvestments at the moment.
"What we have today, we would like to continue to keep, running it on our or own or with a partner," Bufe said.
